title: 7S.2c BLOCK_RECORD parser staging and context-projection retained-byte accounting
scope: Remove parallel parser-owned BLOCK_RECORD copies and account the public record and persistent parsing-context projections before publication.

change.summary: The parser now stages one DRW_Block_Record by move, charges its name/preview/BLKREFS payload to its retained lease, scopes duplicate-detection scratch to the active row, and reserves the persistent BlockRecordInfo context projection before callbacks.

generatedControl.input: Locally generated in-memory ASCII DXF with two BLOCK_RECORD rows, distinct long names, 32/48-byte previews, and two/one BLKREFS handles.
checks: exact measured limit publishes both callback records and complete context projections
post-read retained-byte usage equals one public owner plus one context projection
one byte below the exact limit refuses before any callback or context-map publication
same-facade exact-budget retry succeeds and both handles resolve

evidenceCeiling: The generated controls verify retained-byte accounting and callback/context publication boundaries for the named BLOCK_RECORD parser path. They do not establish DWG/DXF format conformance or support qualification.
selfUnblockingContinuation: Continue the exact-source audit across remaining compound/class registries and parser staging containers. If that audit finds no local owner gap, resume evidence-ready PAR-03/PAR-04 associative field-context work or a locally demonstrated HATCH/DWG semantic issue. External qualification remains optional and does not block local implementation.
